observations: Defining bpbtype before GetBP in DOS7_CONFIG lets MASM emit short BX displacements in four existing instructions, reducing the routine by five bytes.
All 20 local dispatch entries now have the target offsets; six external entries still require linked validation.
limitations: Isolated trial builds on the earlier dsk_init relocation hypothesis and generated historical inputs.
Other routines, complete linkage and target binary are not yet validated; formal msdisk.asm has not been changed.
